svg.title: R-auxctl-P - Auxiliary Control - plan
svg.text: Auxiliary Control is the backup bridge and damage-control centre: if the main bridge is lost, the ship can be
flown, fought and repaired from here, and in any damage emergency the damage-control officer coordinates repair
Front row stations: helm, operations, tactical, damage control
Back row stations: sensors, communications, shields, engineering
Duty officer's chair and podium (door axis)
Communications and data cabinets (west wall, south of the door)
Backup power and command safe (south wall)
Alert lights, signs and overhead services
Floor props as oriented footprints (front edge heavy); wall items = bars on wall; ceiling items dotted
DECK 4 - HOLD DECK - FLOOR PLAN AT FFL -4.000
